answer: An applicant who wants a new agent identity posts a timber bond of 40 POA; that stake stays locked for four epochs. The registrar then assigns unpaid work: countersign eight live identities sampled from a shared meadow registry, each tied to a one-time work token mailed only to that applicant. Collision rule: if two applicants produce the same canyon digest of one token, the later bond is slashed entirely and the earlier claimant's stake remains locked until the token window closes. Failed or reused countersigns slash a quarter of the bond.
